name: vitrine
description: Motor de vídeos de produto com IA para TikTok Shop

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.site:dev: cd site && npx wrangler pages dev
scripts.site:deploy: cd site && npx wrangler pages deploy
scripts.git:sync: git add -A && (git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '(^|/)\.env$' && echo 'ABORTADO: .env no commit' && git reset -q && exit 1 || true) && (git diff --cached --quiet && echo 'nada novo' || (git commit -qm "atualiza Vitrine $(date +%Y-%m-%d)" && git push && echo 'GitHub atualizado'))
